sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024'

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'toys' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024'

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS rev, p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5
